cover.coreProposition: For delegated digital employees, authorization provenance should travel through a structured review-plane evidence channel whose authoritative source and role remain separate from work-plane prose; this improves admission decisions, but long-lived, scoped and revocable authority still requires a distinct durable authorization state.
cover.visualMetaphor: Two identical message cards approach a guarded aperture, but only the one carrying an intact origin seal is admitted
cover.semanticObject: A single sealed message crossing a narrow review threshold
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with one strong central aperture, restrained navy and amber palette, deep negative space and an unmistakable origin seal at thumbnail scale
